title: ItemsHUD
description: This is a mod that adds a HUD to the clock and compass!
body:
## This is a mod that adds a HUD to the clock and compass

The compass shows the coordinates.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23a360cc7ab84e2cfea571a1c67fbe2f23f1c786.png)

The clock shows the current day and time in 24-hour format.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e04db7485be186ce5e15ce3912a26cbc9991f10_0.webp)

## Can be held in the other hand

You can take both.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae04a1f5b640dded5b189fa26978b97896ae5e8d_0.webp)

**You can customize the mod in the settings menu using the mod menu.**
